objective: Prove, for every law that composes like cycles: (1) every fibre of a system's top image over the assignments to a fixed set of variables has the same size; (2) every top image is rectangular for every split of its variables; (3) some ternary polymorphism F satisfies F(a,b,b) = a and F(a,a,b) = b modulo the top of the range generated by a and b; (4) on a knot range, every subrange meeting two top classes meets them all and inherits the top, so F is Mal'tsev modulo the top of every knot range, which is Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001; (5) a law composes like cycles exactly when every range has a top, every tie is a bijection modulo the tops, and some ternary polymorphism is Mal'tsev modulo the top of every knot range.
status: Proved by AFFINE-TOPS-20261021-001A-P001 (V1 prose proof with randomized and exhaustive checks; the overlap proof's Theorem 2, the top lemma, the images proof's Theorem 1 and the classical strong-rectangularity argument cited). In a law that composes like cycles, all nonempty fibres of a top image over assignments to a fixed set of variables have one size, so every top image is rectangular for every split; on the system of ternary polymorphisms this yields a polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the top of the range generated by its two arguments. On a knot range, a subrange meeting two top classes meets them all and inherits the top, so that polymorphism is Mal'tsev modulo the top of every knot range: Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 holds. A law composes like cycles exactly when every range has a top, ties are bijections modulo the tops, and some ternary polymorphism is Mal'tsev modulo the top of every knot range.
title: Proof: rectangular top images and Conjecture 7
